name: Lukian.ai – AI Photo Enhancement
author: mariusgroze

sections.description:
Lukian.ai is the ultimate AI-powered photo enhancement plugin for real estate professionals. Transform your property photos in seconds with our advanced AI technology.

Key Features

  • Virtual Staging – Add furniture to empty rooms instantly
  • Sky Replacement – Replace gray skies with perfect blue skies
  • HD Enhancement – Improve lighting, colors, and image quality
  • Renovation Preview – Show renovation potential to buyers
  • Empty Room – Remove furniture to show space potential
  • Lawn Enhancement – Transform patchy lawns into perfect green grass
  • Twilight Conversion – Convert day photos to stunning dusk scenes
  • Pool Enhancement – Make pools crystal clear and inviting
  • 25+ AI Presets – Wide variety of enhancement options

Perfect For

  • Real Estate Agents
  • Property Managers
  • Real Estate Photographers
  • Real Estate Agencies
  • Property Portals
  • Interior Designers

Houzez Theme Integration

Seamless integration with the popular Houzez WordPress theme:

  • Credit allocation via subscription packages
  • Per-user monthly limits
  • Dashboard integration with enhance buttons
  • Automatic credit management
  • Gallery overlay enhancement

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Get your API key from lukian.ai
  3. Enter the API key in Settings
  4. Start enhancing your property photos!

Shortcode Support

Use [lukianai_studio] to embed the enhancement studio anywhere on your site.

Shortcode attributes:
* history="hide" – Hide history section
* feedback="hide" – Hide feedback form
* credits="hide" – Hide credits display

External Service

This plugin connects to the Lukian.ai API service to process images. When you use this plugin:

  • Your images are sent to lukian.ai servers for AI processing
  • The processed images are returned and can be saved to your Media Library
  • An API key (free to obtain) is required to use this service
  • Credits are consumed for each image processed

Service Links:
* Service Website: https://lukian.ai
* Terms of Service: https://lukian.ai/terms-of-service/
* Privacy Policy: https://lukian.ai/privacy-policy/

Third Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

Lucide Icons
* Description: Beautiful & consistent icon toolkit
* Version: 0.562.0
* Source Code: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
* License: ISC License
* File: assets/js/lucide.min.js
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lukian-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Lukian.ai > Settings and enter your API key
  4. Start using Lukian.ai Studio!

Getting Your API Key

  1. Visit lukian.ai and create a free account
  2. Get 25 free credits to try the service
  3. Copy your API key from the Account section
  4. Paste it in WordPress under Lukian.ai > Settings

For Houzez Theme Users

  1. Enable Houzez integration in Settings
  2. Configure credit limits per user or package
  3. Users will see enhance buttons in their dashboard
  4. Credits are automatically tracked per user
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

The plugin is 100% free! You only pay for credits when you need them. New accounts receive 25 free credits to try the service.

What are credits?

Each image enhancement costs 1 credit. You can purchase credits at lukian.ai starting from €10 for 100 credits.

What image formats are supported?

JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images up to 12MB are supported.

How long does processing take?

Most enhancements complete in 10-30 seconds depending on the complexity.

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes! The plugin works with any WordPress theme. Special enhanced integration is available for the Houzez real estate theme.

Is there a limit on images?

No limit on how many images you can process. You just need credits in your account.

Where are my images processed?

Images are securely sent to Lukian.ai servers for AI processing. We use industry-standard encryption and do not store your images longer than necessary for processing.

Can I get a refund for credits?

If you’re not satisfied with a result, you can request a refund through the feedback system in the plugin.

Do you offer bulk discounts?

Yes! Credit prices decrease as you purchase more. See our pricing at lukian.ai/pricing.

  • 25+ AI enhancement presets including:
    • Interior: Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Minimalist, Luxury and more
    • Exterior: Sky replacement, lawn enhancement, twilight conversion
    • Renovation: Before/after visualization
    • Custom AI Edit: Describe your own enhancement
  • Full Houzez theme integration
  • Credit management system with per-user limits
  • [lukianai_studio] shortcode for embedding
  • Feedback system with refund requests
  • History tracking with Photo IDs
  • Media Library integration
  • Responsive design for all devices
